title: The little library where the loans are alive
text: FERNHAVEN — On Quay Street, in a building that once housed the town's lifeboat, the shelves hold something unusual: seeds, drawer after drawer of them, free to anyone who asks. The seed library, founded in 2014 by retired schoolteacher Maren Odell, lends vegetable and flower seed on a simple promise — grow it, save some, bring it back. 'People thought I was daft,' Odell says. 'Now they queue.'
notes: Regional-newspaper register. Plants the first of the three conflicting founding answers: 'founded in 2014'. Also corroborates founder, location, and purpose.
